image named by the shipped shader 'models/mapobjects/cosmoflash/tele4_frame' that no pinned archive provides. ParseStage returns qfalse when R_FindImageFile fails, and R_FindShader then sets shader.defaultShader for the *whole* shader (ioq3 code/renderergl2/tr_shader.c), so every surface drawn through it renders untextured rather than losing one layer. Accepted because the audit measured how much geometry that is.

a target_speaker noise key of maps/am_underworks2.bsp names a sound no pinned OpenArena release ships. The closure resolves the name as written; the engine opens it with '.wav' appended (ioq3 code/game/g_target.c SP_target_speaker), and neither name exists, so the reference dangles either way and a missing sound is silence
